method.ICT1: 09:30-11:30 entry window; low sweep->long/high sweep->short, confirmed opposite swing close-cross in middle or third FVG bar, strictly after sweep. Three exits2R,3R,oppositeON fixed at order. Gap+MSS known only after final thirdbar closes.
method.ICT2: Separate AM10:00-11:00 and PM14:00-15:00. FADE is first directional FVG after priorhour sweep, back toward prior range. CONTINUE reverses direction (high sweep->long). At confirmation continuation additionally requires an untouched PDH/ONH (long) or PDL/ONL(short), strictly beyond current completed RTHextreme. Closest qualifying draw stored; targets remain fixed2R/3R. No discretionary news filter or extra unrequested fractal-MSS requirement for this first-FVG model.
method.ICT3: First shakeout at least0.15priorATR from selected anchor09:30/08:30 during09:30-10:15. Bull-long requires priorbull, bearish mirroredshort requires priorbear. First matching FVG with thirdbar close strictly back above09:30open(long)/below(short), entry before10:30. Fixed exits2R,3R,TIME15:55open. BOTH includes both regime-aligned directions; BULL_LONG retains only original bullish rule.
method.bars: Signals use aligned1m or5m bars from08:00NY; incomplete source blocks invalidate structure and pending sweep chain. New RTH day resets all state. All execution and DD remain on raw1m. No forming-bar entries.
method.chain: First strict sweep per level-side/window. Both-side sweeps in one signal-timeframe bar skipped as ambiguous; no claimed intrabar sequence. Sweep bar must complete before FVG middle-bar starts. Store extreme through completed confirmation, freeze at order. No reentry, one first candidate order/model/window even if unfilled or invalid target.
method.comparisons: Frozen B149 and S1/S2 reused without modification and audited from committed ledgers. Standalone comparison uses full cash calendar incl zeros, ATR_R, points, tradePF and minute-markDD. Also daily correlation, overlap count, and descriptive equal0.5baseline+0.5ICT separate-sleeve panels (costs linearly scaled, no integerMNQ or ordernetting). Compare DAILY close DD/Sharpe to same endpoint baseline; overlapping sleeves allowed and explicitly counted. No future conflict exclusions or frozen benchmark trade substitutions.
method.displacement: User accepted mirrored bearish Judas counterpart and delegated displacement choice. Fixed before outcomes: gap>=0.03priorATR AND signed middle-candle body>=0.03priorATR. No threshold optimization. 0.10priorATR minimum stop widened structurally, never excluded for smaller initial distance.
method.entries: First limit at bullish Low[t] or bearish High[t], active from next1m boundary only; cancel unfilled at window end. Primary touch fill at quoted level, no favorable improvement. Separate paired one-tick trade-through fill sensitivity, not another parameter search. Entry-bar stop wins. Entry-bar target only if entry known atopen or closing price proves a later target cross. Later-open target before later intrabarstop; unresolved intrabarSL/TP stopfirst. Gapped stop fills adverse actualopen and can exceed1stopR. Targets touch; no exactqueue/fillcertificate.
method.fractal: The supplied definition is FIVE bars, strict2left+2right; known after center+2 closes. Equal highs/lows not pivots. Latest already confirmed opposite swing before crossing bar; no current-bar redefinition.
method.inference: 20000 moving2-calendar-month blocks with fixedseeds2026102511/+1, no era crossing, joint same draws across all80 objects. Basic nominal95CI and centered two-sided p on mean ATR_R/fullcashday. Also paired incremental mean versus fixed B. Global Holm480=80variants x3periods x2contrasts(zero,B). Touch family primary; trade-through is fixed execution sensitivity, reported without rescue p-values. No choice on significance; exploratory consumed-data p cannot certify independently profitable model.
method.interpretation: Explicit mechanical operationalization inspired by ICT and user definitions; not certification of authentic discretionary ICT, dealer intent, stop pools or profitable institutional causation.
method.levels: ICT1 two explicit pre-RTH level families: ON18:00(previouscivil)-09:30, PRE08:30-09:30. London is contained within ON, not a third post-hoc03:00 subgroup. Require every expected minute for a level; use available scheduled source data with no price filling. ICT2 AM priorhour09:00-10:00, PM13:00-14:00; snapshot known at window start. ICT3 anchors09:30open and08:30open separately.
method.outputs: All80specs x3periods for primary and pairedfillsensitivity, per-quarter aggregates, direction splits and causal chain/qualitycounts. Private event/trade/path/dailypanels stay Gitignored. Full rawsource reconstruction twice; byte-identical outputs; hash-check ALL pre-existing tracked files including current public benchmark and playbook.
method.risk: ICT1/3 stop1tick beyond observed sweep-extreme; ICT2 stop1tick beyond t-2low(long)/high(short). Widen to at least0.10priorATR and round outward0.25tick. $24.50RT=1.225pt per filled trade. No BE/trailing, all flat15:55open. StopR=netpoints/initial_stopdistance, ATR_R=netpoints/priorATR14. PF/Sharpe/DD in BOTH units; common ATR_R is benchmark scale. StopR is not ATR_R or accountROI.
method.universe: Same1171 cash sessions for accounting (749old+422recent), same1151 ATR-ready complete source entry sessions (733+418). Holidays/short/missing sessions remain flat, not newly repaired. No cross-era history. Prerequisite coverage per model reported. SMA20 prior strict consecutive cash closes; bull yesterday>SMA20, bear yesterday<SMA20 (ties neither).
